question.text: Which NISM certification is required for dealers/representatives trading in exchange-traded interest rate derivatives?

answer.text: NISM Series IV (Interest Rate Derivatives) or NISM Series XIII (Common Derivatives)
No NISM certification is required for IRD trading

explanation.text: The Logic: Dealers trading in ETIRD must hold either NISM Series IV certification (specific to Interest Rate Derivatives) or NISM Series XIII (Common Derivatives Certification that covers multiple derivative segments). The Trap: Series VIII is for equity derivatives, not IRD. Series I is for currency derivatives. NISM certification IS mandatory for approved users/dealers in the IRD segment. Cross-Exam Context: Each derivative segment has its own NISM certification requirement. Series XIII provides a common alternative that covers multiple segments. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Series IV is the specialized certification for IRD. Series XIII offers a broader qualification covering multiple derivative segments, which may be more cost-effective for multi-segment dealers.
